Context: 6. Permanent transfer to and from Central Autonomous/Statutory Bodies Counting of past service for pension

5. Absorption of employees of one Central Autonomous Body in another Central Autonomous Body.The provisions enumerated in the preceding paragraphs will apply mutatis mutandis in respect of employees going from one Central Autonomous Body to another.
